title: Pros Runtime Skill Quality Standard
goal: Define and execute a consistent quality standard for all Pros runtime skills, including structure sections, precise trigger descriptions, openai.yaml alignment, workflow-resource entry points, and representative forward-testing.

included: scripts/validate-runtime-files.js if validator precision needs adjustment
excluded: Implementing feature code beyond plan artifacts in this planning pass

apiContracts.rationale: The plan concerns local runtime documentation, metadata, validation and QA workflow. No frontend/backend or service boundary is introduced.

constraints: Use skill-creator as reference guidance only; do not modify it as part of this plan.
Keep Pros business-facing German language natural and domain-specific.
Do not add placeholder sections; every standard section must contain actionable routing or execution guidance.
Do not change optional openai.yaml icon or brand fields unless the SKILL.md change makes existing metadata stale.
Forward-testing prompts must not leak intended fixes or expected answers.

tasks.title: Derive the Pros runtime skill quality standard
acceptanceCriteria: A compact standard defines required skill sections, trigger rules, YAML rules, openai.yaml rules, workflow-resource entry points, and forward-test rules.
The standard references skill-creator guidance without changing skill-creator.

tasks.title: Create a complete runtime skill and workflow-resource inventory
acceptanceCriteria: Every runtime skill has recorded status for frontmatter, description, When to use, When NOT to use, Core Rules, and agents/openai.yaml.
Workflow resource files are tracked separately from top-level workflow files.

tasks.title: Add missing standard sections to all runtime skills
acceptanceCriteria: All runtime skills have meaningful When to use, When NOT to use, and Core Rules sections.
Existing skill intent and safety boundaries are preserved.

tasks.title: Improve YAML trigger descriptions
acceptanceCriteria: Every skill description states what the skill does and specific contexts that should trigger it.
Descriptions reduce false positives and preserve German business terminology where appropriate.

tasks.title: Align agents/openai.yaml with SKILL.md
acceptanceCriteria: Existing openai.yaml display_name, short_description, and default_prompt match the revised SKILL.md intent.
Optional icon and brand fields remain unchanged unless explicitly stale.

tasks.title: Add entry points to workflow resource files
acceptanceCriteria: Every workflow resource file has a meaningful Entry Points section.
The section explains when the parent workflow should load or use the resource.

tasks.title: Review and refine runtime validator behavior
acceptanceCriteria: A decision is documented on whether section issues remain warnings or become stricter checks.
Validator behavior avoids false positives for workflow resource files or documents why those files use workflow rules.

tasks.title: Define representative forward-testing protocol
acceptanceCriteria: The protocol covers at least one business skill, one tool skill, one security or automation skill, and one workflow-resource context.
Prompts are written like real user requests and do not leak expected fixes.

tasks.title: Run representative forward-tests and fold findings back into skills
acceptanceCriteria: Representative trigger and non-trigger cases are exercised.
Observed misunderstandings lead to concrete SKILL.md/openai.yaml changes or documented follow-ups.

tasks.title: Run release gates and regression checks
acceptanceCriteria: mise run runtime-validate succeeds with no new warnings from the targeted standard work.
mise run release-check succeeds or any remaining warnings are existing and explicitly documented.
npm run release:dry-run is run if release metadata or packaging behavior is affected.

tasks.title: Update completion notes and decision log
acceptanceCriteria: Plan progress notes summarize final checks and residual risks.
Any accepted tech debt is recorded in docs/plans/work/tech-debt-tracker.md.

doneWhen: All runtime skills satisfy the new Pros runtime skill quality standard.
All current skill and workflow-resource structure warnings are fixed or intentionally reclassified with rationale.
Trigger descriptions are precise and consistent enough to reduce false activation.
Existing agents/openai.yaml files align with the corresponding SKILL.md files.
Representative forward-testing is defined and required before completion.
Runtime validation and release checks pass or remaining warnings are explicitly documented as non-blocking.

decisionLog.rationale: The work affects many runtime skills, workflow resources, metadata alignment, validation behavior, and QA forward-testing.

decisionLog.decision: Use skill-creator as a reference only.
decisionLog.rationale: The user requested skill-creator be included as guidance, not changed as part of the standardization work.
No cross-boundary API or service interface is part of this plan.
